description: Renewable Energy Share In The Total Final Energy Consumption, Annual is a dataset listed in Singapore open data portal (data.gov.sg), an open data portal, published or maintained by Singapore Department of Statistics. Source: ENERGY MARKET AUTHORITY Data Last Updated: 02/12/2025 Update Frequency: Annual Footnotes: Data refer to the percentage of final consumption of energy that is derived from renewable resources. Renewable energy consumption includes consumption of energy derived from: hydro, solid biofuels, wind, solar, liquid biofuels, biogas, geothermal, marine and waste. Coverage: Singapore. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sg-dgs-portal.
